title: Watership Down
author: Richard Adams
summary: A small group of rabbits flees their doomed warren after one of them has a vision of disaster, and they travel across the English countryside to found a new home, facing predators and rival warrens on the way.
readIf: you want an animal story that is also a full-blooded adventure, with its own language and mythology.
skipIf: you want a soft read; there is real violence and loss.

pairings.reason: A younger, cosier animal adventure with feasts and heroes rather than grim survival.
A calm, riverside animal classic with the danger turned down.
Another animal-centred quest with a mythic, melancholy tone.
